dpwh-arcgis-congdist-layer-info.title: Congressional District FeatureServer layer 0 — metadata
dpwh-arcgis-congdist-layer-info.notes: Layer 0 of DPWH ArcGIS FeatureServer. Polygon districts, fields ISLAND/REGION/PROVINCE/CONG_DIST/POP2010/POP2015, native SR WGS84 UTM 51N (wkid 32651). Copyright line: 'Original source from NAMRIA rectified digitally by the GIA Staff of Statistics Division, Planning Service, DPWH (As of March 2022)'. 245 features = 19th Congress vintage, NOT the 2025/254-seat baseline (pre-dates RA 11593 Bulacan 5th/6th and the Maguindanao del Norte/Sur split). Value: per-district polygons for split cities (Manila 1-6, QC, Makati, Caloocan, etc.) — candidate input for the barangay-split stretch goal, not for 2025 assignment.

dpwh-arcgis-congdist-geojson.title: Congressional District polygons — full geometry, reprojected to WGS84
dpwh-arcgis-congdist-geojson.notes: 245 district polygons as GeoJSON (outSR=4326, reprojected from native wkid 32651). Fetched verbatim from the ArcGIS FeatureServer query endpoint; no post-processing. Same 2022 vintage caveat as dpwh-arcgis-congdist-layer-info.
